verdict.rationale: Pulumi's `pulumi preview` command validates configuration and surfaces errors before applying changes, and language-native testing frameworks (docs-3/15/24) can catch config issues, but there is no evidence of a built-in auto-format capability — since Pulumi uses general-purpose languages (TS/Python/Go), formatting would rely on external tools like Prettier or gofmt rather than a Pulumi-provided feature.
